response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong software engineering credentials with 20+ years of experience and currently works on AI infrastructure, the role requires specialized expertise in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, and hardware-level performance optimization for AI accelerators. The candidate's background is primarily in application-level software development and web infrastructure, with no evident experience in hardware architecture, micro-architecture simulation, or deep learning workload optimization on accelerators. This represents a fundamental domain mismatch rather than a skills gap.
strengths: 20+ years of diverse technical experience across embedded systems, infrastructure, and AI-agent frameworks demonstrates solid engineering foundation
Strong systems thinking evident from work with microservices, databases, and infrastructure-as-code (Kubernetes, AWS, Docker)
Currently working on AI infrastructure and developer tooling at re:cinq, showing recent exposure to AI-related technologies
concerns: No experience with SoC, IP modeling, or hardware architecture design—the core technical requirement of the role
No demonstrated expertise in GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD optimization, or AI accelerator performance analysis
Background is primarily in application-level software and web platforms, not hardware-software co-design or micro-architecture performance optimization
